name: Fungi — decomposers, mycorrhizal partners and glowing kinds
notes: Fungi are not plants and do not read climate the way plants do: they read DEAD MATTER. substrate: snag_log (fruits on standing dead trees and fallen logs, and rots them), litter (leaf mould and dead grass), mycorrhizal (lives on living tree roots of the named hosts and fruits under them), dung (herbivore dung), carcass (carcass and midden ground), burn (last year's fire scar). Moisture and temperature only gate WHEN they fruit: a few days after rain in their season. Glowing kinds are real: foxfire on honey-fungus wood, ghost fungus, jack-o'-lantern, and the glowing bonnets — they are the natural night lights of the forest floor and belong to the R1a teal/green accent. Edible: yes / cook / no / poison / deadly — the forage system reads it.
